page.layout: One printed page, a title page centred on the scan; every printed line is one line of the title. No running head, no page number, no margin text. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is left out.

main_text.l: Secunda Editio, ex ipsius Authoris exemplari auctior.

page.notes: The title is set in mixed roman, italic and spaced capitals; the italic lines are rendered here without markup because the title is a list of lines. The small ink specks across the scan are not text and are left out. The bottom-right "Digitized by Google" mark is a digitiser's stamp and is left out.
